opening.argument: The video ties its instructions directly to the 4Sage.io platform and directs viewers through creating a MetaMask wallet, including handling the wallet's Secret Recovery Phrase. The MetaMask screens visibly require the phrase to be written down and then confirmed, while the speaker instructs viewers to use a photograph while completing the backup. Requesting this highly sensitive credential in the context of joining the named platform is more than a neutral wallet tutorial. The video does not explain why 4Sage.io needs the phrase or establish a legitimate reason for requiring this setup.
